page.overview:
Who is Bryant?

Bryant was a minor character who briefly appeared in first season. He was a member of a group that worshipped an ancient being known as Ka-Hor, and he sought to unearth his tomb in order to free him from his centuries long imprisonment.

Upon unearthing Ka-Hor’s tomb and awakening him, Bryant was possessed by Ka-Hor due to a curse that required him to inhabit a living host in order to escape. Before Ka-Hor could escape, however, a sandstorm inadvertently caused by Invincible sealed the tomb once more and trapped both of them inside. Bryant eventually died after being trapped for so long, leaving Ka-Hor without a host.

Bryant also had a daughter named Jane who, together with another woman and minor superhuman named Riley, eventually rediscovered the tomb, where she found the desiccated remains of her father before encountering Ka-Hor.

He was an American/Australian male with dark brown hair and a peach-fuzz beard. He was seen wearing a yellow jacket, green shirt, khaki pants, and a white scarf. He was shown smoking and was notable for having a scarab beetle tattoo on his right hand, signifying his devotion to Ka-Hor.
